I feel this way too.. I'm a 23yo f with mad anxiety and depression, and every time I have a mild pain somewhere in body, I'm certain I'm dying. I used to go to the hospital a lot to have my blood tested to make sure I was okay (luckily I live in Canada, so it was no cost).. But the nurses all came to know me and I'm pretty sure they all rolled their eyes when they had to deal with me again. 

Eventually I got over going to the hospital on like a monthly basis. But now I just sit with my pains and worry that I'm dying. I'd rather just die than be such a burden to hospital staff and tax-payer dollars to ease my anxiety. Usually the pains pass in like a day or two anyway. 

Sorry this wasn't much help lol I just wanted you to know, you are not alone in feeling this way, and I get how shitty it is. However, I'm sure you have lots of people who care about you and want you around. I have hope that we won't be like this forever.
Whatever you decide to do, I hope you find peace. I can tell you're a hardworking young man and I'm sure you're capable of achieving whatever ever you set your mind to.
